b: I was on the $60/month Cursor plan. When I was offered the switch to the Super plan, it said I'd get 2.5x my current usage. On the strength of that, I upgraded and paid for a full year up front.
A few days in, it's clearly less value, not more:
No model credits. My $60 plan came with about $60 of credits to use on other models. The Super plan has nothing like that.

One shared weekly allowance. I used to have a monthly allowance for Cursor plus separate usage for Grok Bot. Now it's all one weekly pool shared between Cursor and Grok Bot, and it runs out well before the week ends.
No way to measure it. They don't show credit numbers, so you can't compare the plans directly. But with the same usage as before, I'm hitting the limit much sooner.
I've emailed support asking for a refund of the annual payment and to be moved back to my $60/month plan. The "2.5x" claim feels like a false promise.
Has anyone else switched and seen the same thing? Did anyone manage to get a refund or go back to their old plan?
